name: Gorrow the Mire-King
what: Act One, Relic-Bearer of the Mire, the Mire Pearl set in his crown of reeds. Belly-Flop, Drag Under, Wallow, Undertow.
about: A frog-king as wide as a hut: warty green skin blotched with orange rings, a pale sagging belly, great gold eyes, and the Mire Pearl set in a crown of woven reeds and cattails. 1.1 m to the top of his head (1.55 m to the cattails), 1.6 m across.
